description_en: Queries the traffic destination of a specified endpoint by calling the DescribeCustomRoutingEndPointTrafficPolicy operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeCustomRoutingEndPointTrafficPolicy接口查询指定终端节点流量通行目标
name: DescribeCustomRoutingEndPointTrafficPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic destination to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的流量通行目标ID
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint whose traffic destination you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询流量通行目标的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance to which the endpoint belongs
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 终端节点所属全球加速实例ID

Address.description_en: The IP address of the traffic destination

Endpoint.description_en: The name of the vSwitch to which the traffic destination belongs
Endpoint.description_zh: 流量通行目标所属终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例的名称

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点所属终端节点组ID

EndpointId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint to which the traffic destination belongs
EndpointId.description_zh: 流量通行目标所属终端节点ID

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener to which the endpoint belongs

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the traffic destination

PortRanges.description_en: The port range of the traffic destination
PortRanges.description_zh: 流量通行目标端口范围

items.description_en: The port range over which the traffic destination processes requests
items.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的端口范围

FromPort.description_en: The start port of the port range over which the traffic destination processes requests
FromPort.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的起始端口

ToPort.description_en: The end port of the port range over which the traffic destination processes requests
ToPort.description_zh: 流量通行目标处理请求的结束端口

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:

true: The instance is managed.

false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.
When the instance is in the managed state, operations that the user can perform on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: creates an instance.
Update: updates the current instance.
Delete: deletes the current instance.
Associate: references or is referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: unmanages the instance.
CreateChild: creates a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:
Listener: listener resource.
IpSet: acceleration region resource.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource.
Endpoint: endpoint resource.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping resource of the endpoint group under a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: traffic policy resource of the endpoint under a custom routing listener.
This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the traffic destination. Valid values:
init: being initialized.
active: Normal.
updating: being updated.
deleting: being deleted
State.description_zh:
流量通行目标的状态。
init：初始化。
active：正常。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中
